senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unselected.
2 Uncovered.
3 Unprotected.
E.
अ neg. वृत chosen, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Enclosed, surrounded, (by a ditch, wall, &c.)
2 Covered, screened.
3 Invested, inclosed, involved.
4 Spread, overspread, overcast.
5 Filled with, abounding with.
m. (-तः)
A man of mixed origin, the son of a Brahman, by a woman of the Ugra caste.
E.
आङ्, वृ to nourish, affix क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Whirled, stirred, turned round.
2 Reverted, averted.
3 Retreated, fled.
E.
आङ् before वृत to be, क्त aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
Inadequate support, absence of subsistence or allowance.
E.
अ neg. वृत्ति maintenance.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Reversion, turning back or from.
2 Flight, retreat.
3 Revolving, going round.
4 Wordly existence, the revolution of births.
5 Use, employment, application.
E.
आङ् before वृत, क्तिन् aff.

ind.
Successfully, profitably.
E.
अ not, वृथा vainly.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Succeeding, gaining one's object.
E.
अवृथा not in vain, अर्थ object.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Not bearing interest.
2 Not augmentative.
E.
अ neg. वृद्धि increase, ठक् aff.

f. (-वृत्)
Order, method.
E.
आङ् before वृत to choose, affix क्विप्.
